scope: USER_FIXED_EXISTING_84; no prediction generation; no expansion to other 57
spurs_source: Official spurs.pkl via original DDGPredictor. Never substitute independent rerun cache.
pace_source: Frozen existing six-member M6; (mean P + mean C)/2
paired_sampling: Run official select_training_data once under saved/restored NumPy RNG seeded with repeat seed; share exact rows and order across all arms
preprocessing: Official dense 24-channel encoding and sqrt(1/reg_coef) block scaling; NO z-score
ridge: Unmodified upstream BaseRegressionPredictor.train; sklearn 1.0.2 Ridge(alpha=rc) defaults
metric: Unmodified upstream utils.metric_utils.spearman; variance<1e-6 returns zero
smoke_gate: Correctness only; no score or winner threshold
common_base: One Base fit shared by two contrasts; separate smoke Base replay must agree exactly
summaries: Per N: mean 20 repeats per assay then equal assay weights. Full84 and homology-excluded separately. Cross-N separate available-N reporting.
